subject: Booth plan: swag placement, traffic flow & signage zoning
messages:
From: Allie Rivera <allie@alliedexpo.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudScale Ops <ops@cloudscale-summit.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Booth logistics — power riser & recommended clearance

Hi Neha,

Hope all is well — excited to have Redwood Inference in Hall C. A couple quick notes after walk-through: 

- The official utility riser in front of Row C-12 (your island) has a max load of 20A per circuit. If you plan for demo machines + charging stations + LED signage, that's going to push you close to the limit.
- There are two cross-aisle pinch points to the south of your footprint at 11:30am and 2:45pm (based on badge dump from 2025) — heavy traffic. We recommend locating high-traffic engagement activities (giveaways, selfie wall) away from those flows.

Attached is the updated hall floorplan with power access points highlighted. Would you like us to reserve an additional 20A feed (there's a lead time and surcharge)? Also tell me if you want the peninsula opening oriented toward the north or east — that changes the flow map.

Attachments: RWDW-floorplan_v2.pdf (schematic, 2 pages)

Best,
Allie Rivera
Exhibitor Relations — AlliedExpo
allie@alliedexpo.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Allie Rivera <allie@alliedexpo.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-08T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booth logistics — power riser & recommended clearance

Thanks Allie — this is super helpful. Quick answers: 

- Can you hold an extra 20A feed for us as a provisional option? If there's a firm cutoff, please let me know (we can decide by Friday 11/13).
- For traffic: we want the demo area on the quieter side and giveaways centrally located but off the cross-aisle. Proposed: demo pods on the east-facing peninsula, swag table slightly inset on the north face with a staffed lead to manage the queue.

Internal note to Dylan/Tessa/Stephanie (please weigh in):
- Dylan: do we need all demo machines powered through the riser, or can we run a small UPS rack and use fewer circuits? See attached swag inventory so we can plan what needs power.
- Tessa: signage zoning — we have a 10ft backwall and two 3x6 side banners. Is the selfie backdrop still planned? If so, it should be moved to the NE corner to avoid the 2:45pm bottleneck.
- Stephanie: ordering deadline for branded lanyards and tote bags is 11/12 to hit the show. Are we on track?

Attachments: swag_inventory_2026.xlsx

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@eventprints.co>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booth logistics — signage dimensions & production timeline

Hi Neha / Tessa,

Quick follow-up from production:
- Backwall (10ft) artwork: we need final print-ready file by 11/12 to meet the 11/20 delivery window. Bleed + crop instructions attached.
- The selfie backdrop (6x8) requires a metal frame and sandbags if placed near the aisle — recommend 2 sandbags per leg.
- Vinyl decals for floor wayfinding: we can do 4 directional decals (18x24) — just confirm wording.

We also have a staging suggestion: shift the swag bins 18 inches inward from the outer edge and use a shallow riser so event staff can see the demo area. That helps reduce accidental congestion during giveaways.

Attachments: print_spec_instructions.pdf (1 page) — link: https://orders.eventprints.co/quote/CS-9132

Thanks,
Sam Chen
Senior Production Manager — EventPrints
sam.chen@eventprints.co
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booth logistics — power riser & recommended clearance

Thanks Allie and Sam — quick tech check from my side:
- We can run demo machines off two dedicated 10A circuits if we deploy one compact UPS (PDUs on UPS) per demo island. That reduces the peak draw significantly. UPS vendor quotes attached (est. 45 lb per unit).
- If we want LED edge-lighting for the backwall, count an extra 1.5A per meter. Recommend a dimmer to curtail peaks.

Action items for internal:
1) Approve provisional extra 20A feed (Allie) by 11/13 if possible.
2) Neha/Tessa: confirm selfie backdrop location and final copy for floor decals by 11/12.
3) Stephanie: confirm lanyard/tote order shipped by 11/12.

Attachments: power_rack_diagram.png, ups_vendor_quotes.pdf

-Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Allie Rivera <allie@alliedexpo.com>, Sam Chen <sam.chen@eventprints.co>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-10T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booth logistics — power riser & recommended clearance

Allie / Sam — thanks for the quick turn. Final confirmations below: 

- Allie: please provision the additional 20A feed as optional hold for us. We'll confirm and pay the surcharge if we hit the throughput test on Wednesday 11/18.
- Sam: proceed with the backwall production schedule; we'll upload final artwork to the Drive link by 11/11 6pm PT. Floor decal copy: "Redwood Inference -> Demos this way" (arrow icon).
- Dylan: let's plan two UPS units (on wheels) for the demo islands. Confirmed — we'll take the smaller UPS units you recommended.
- Stephanie/Tessa: Stephanie to confirm lanyard/tote shipment today; Tessa to sign off on selfie backdrop NE corner and send final dimensions to Sam.

Next steps: I'll push an updated site plan to the Drive folder and book a 30-minute sync for Friday 11/12 at 9am PT to finalize orders. If anyone needs to escalate (power, ADA clearance), loop in Allie and CloudScale Ops.

Thanks all — almost there.
